claude.rationale: The slice documents that FCB ceased separate legal existence and deregistered effective January 1, 2019, and that Synovus's subsequent Forms 10-K report only functional company-wide segments with no reporting unit isolating the acquired FCB/Florida business, so no standalone revenue, asset-quality, or operational trajectory is disclosed for the outcome window. There is thus no realized-outcome evidence of product/process incoherence (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) — the only impairment noted ($44.9M in 2020) is explicitly attributed to the pre-existing Consumer Mortgage reporting unit, not to FCB. Because the acquired business's trajectory is absorbed into consolidated results and not separately documented, both pathways are coded uncertain rather than 0.
